about_short_description.short_description: Avail is a team of innovators dedicated to transforming the blockchain world.

product.name: Avail DA
product.description: A data availability layer for blockchain networks that provides fast, verifiable, and privacy-preserving publication and retrieval of transaction data for rollups and other chains.

product.name: Avail Nexus
product.description: A multichain coordination and liquidity layer that lets applications provide bridgeless asset access, unified balances, and cross-chain trading through APIs, SDKs, and interface components.

product.name: Avail FastBridge
product.description: An intent-based, solver-powered bridge for transferring native assets across multiple EVM chains, including consolidating balances from multiple source chains into one destination transaction.

product.name: Avail Atomic
product.description: An API-based execution and settlement service that routes swap orders to centralized-limit-order books and proprietary AMMs, using atomic on-chain settlement to reduce counterparty risk.

product.name: Avail x402
product.description: An upcoming agentic payment layer intended to let AI agents manage and move assets across multiple blockchains.
